The following table lists runtime error IDs the Tcp/Ip shall use for reporting of runtime

[SWS_TcpIp_00256]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Eth_00112
⌈The TcpIp shall report the runtime error by calling Det_ReportRuntimeError(
TCPIP_E_TIMEDOUT) if one of the following conditions applies:
• TcpIp module has sent a SYN to establish a connection but did not receive any
response.
• An established idle TCP connection is closed because the peer is no longer
present, i.e. keep-alive timer runs out and peer does not respond to keep-alive
probes according to IETF RFC 1122 chapter 4.2.3.6 TCP Keep-Alives.
• An established TCP connection is closed because the peer does not respond,
i.e. the maximum number of retransmissions has been sent without acknowl-
edgement, according to [SWS_TcpIp_00202].
